Baby & Toddler Programs in Halton - Water Babies Canada Shop Login Shop Lessons By Age How Our Lessons Work Age 0-1 Team Pearl Age 1 – 2 Team Saffi Age 2-3 Team Echo Age 3-4 Team Sculli Age 4-6 Team Finn Parent Resources Our Fees Explained How To Book Our Lessons Meet Our Teachers Get Ready For Your First Lesson Benefits of Swimming Lessons Blog & News About Us Contact us Our Story FAQs Work with us Head office vacancies Regional vacancies Teacher vacancies Franchise Opportunities Find a class Contact us Find a class Home » Blog » Baby & Toddler Programs in Halton Inside Our Franchises 9 October 2026 Baby & Toddler Programs in Halton Halton Region is a wonderful place for families with babies and toddlers, offering a mix of nature, family-friendly attractions and activities for little ones to explore. Made up of Burlington, Oakville, Milton and Halton Hills, is home to a variety of local attractions, family programs, museums and child-friendly spaces, giving parents plenty of opportunities to discover new activities and enjoy quality time with their little ones. 7 Baby & Toddler Activities in Halton 1) Common Moms Oakville, Milton or Burlington Common Moms brings moms and their little ones together through engaging programs, fun activities and social events. From sensory play and music to movement classes and toddler adventures, sessions offer opportunities for children to explore and learn while moms connect with other families and build lasting friendships in a supportive environment. Website : https://www.thecommonmoms.com/ Social Media : @commonmomsoakville @commonsmomsmilton @commonmomsburlington 2) Joseph Brant Museum This museum in Burlington offers fun, interactive experiences for little learners. Its Toddler Days program is designed for children 2-4 and their caregivers, with hands-on activities centered around a different theme each week. Address : 1240 North Shore Blvd E, Burlington, ON L7S 1C5 Website : https://museumsofburlington.ca/visitor-information/joseph-brant-museum/ Social Media : @museumsburlon 3) Water Babies Halton, Waterloo and Guelph Offers year-round swimming lessons for babies and toddlers aged 0-5, helping them become comfortable and confident in the water from an early age. Through age-appropriate activities, songs and gentle guidance from trained teachers, little swimmers develop essential water safety skills while enjoying quality time with their caregiver in the pool. Address : Multiple Locations Website : https://www.waterbabies.ca/baby-swimming/halton-waterloo-guelph/ Social Media : @waterbabieshaltonwaterlooguelph 4) The WOMB Milton and Burlington The WOMB is a women’s health clinic that runs community programs and events, with a focus on prenatal, postnatal, and overall women’s health support. Their Mom & Baby programs include Baby & Me Fitness or Yoga, Music & Movement, and Stroller Fit, providing opportunities for moms to stay active, connect with other parents, and support their little ones’ development. Website : https://www.thewomb.ca/ Milton Address : 388 Main St E, Milton, ON L9T 1P8 Social Media : @thewombmilton Burlington Address : 1159 King Rd, Burlington, ON L7T 0B4 Social Media : @thewombburlington 5) Mighty Mom Mighty Mom Oakville offers fitness classes for expectant and new moms, with little ones welcome to join. Sessions combine strength training, cardio, core and pelvic floor exercises, with options tailored to different fitness levels and stages of postpartum recovery. Website : https://mightymom.ca/ Social Media : @mightymomoakville 6) Peapod Indoor Playground Peapod Indoor Playground in Oakville provides a fun, indoor space where little ones can play, move and explore. With opportunities for active play and family-friendly events, it’s a great spot for babies and toddlers to enjoy a change of scenery, discover new activities and burn off some energy. Address : 505 Iroquois Shore Rd Unit 10, Oakville, ON L6H 2R3 Website : https://www.peapodplayground.ca/ Social Media : @peapodindoorplaygound 7) Lullaland Lullaland offers instructor-led sensory play classes for babies and toddlers in Oakville, Burlington, and Milton. Each session features a new theme, with engaging props, lights, music, and interactive activities designed to spark curiosity and encourage early development. With programs tailored to different stages, from newborns to toddlers up to 3.5 years old, little ones can explore, learn and develop new skills in a welcoming, inclusive environment. Website : https://www.lullalandsensory.ca/ Social Medi a: @lullalandgtawest Your Halton Baby & Toddler Activity Checklist We offer lessons all over! We bring baby & toddler swimming lessons closer to you – in safe warm, and welcoming venues.
